title: Piña Colada
description: This creamy pina colada cocktail made with a blend of coconut milk, pineapple juice, and rum is a delicious, creamy, and refreshing summer drink.

steps.text: Combine coconut milk, pineapple juice, rum, sugar, and ice in a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

video.description: A good Pina Colada takes summer to the next level, and this 3-ingredient recipe will leave everyone who tastes it impressed. Using simple ingredients like pineapple, coconut milk, and rum, the fruity cocktail drinks easy and still packs some punch. Make a large batch for your next dinner party or make smaller batches for yourself and just a few friends. Follow along with Chef Nicole McLaughlin as she prepares this all time favorite tropical drink, and your summer get togethers will never be the same!
